predecessors.name: Kingdom of Great Britain
predecessors.text: Kuwait, a British protectorate (Anglo-Kuwaiti Agreement of 23 January 1899)

successors.name: Kuwait
successors.text: Kuwait restored on the end of the Iraqi occupation, 26 February 1991

ledger.x: 19 June 1961: Kuwait becomes independent from Britain.
25 July 1966: Kuwait takes its half of the Saudi-Kuwaiti neutral zone.
26 February 1991: the Iraqi occupation of Kuwait ends.
1991: Cliopatria's State of Kuwait row ends and its Kuwait row resumes in 1991 over the same cells.

wars.name: Kuwait crisis of 1961 (Operation Vantage)
wars.outcome: Iraq threatened to invade in July 1961 and did not: the invasion 'was finally averted following plans by the Arab League to form an international Arab force'; British forces had withdrawn by 19 October and the Arab League took over border security.

wars.name: Invasion of Kuwait and Gulf War
wars.outcome: Iraq invaded and annexed Kuwait on 2 August 1990; the occupation ended on 26 February 1991.

certainty.note: Frontiers follow the 1922 Uqair Convention lines with Saudi Arabia and the 1932 line with Iraq, which Iraq accepted in the 1963 treaty.
